racials.tx: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.
racials.note: Zephras shows 5 yd range. theforeverera (build 70170): cannot be used while immune to Physical damage.

racials.name: Will of the Forsaken
racials.tx: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

racials.name: Touch of the Grave
racials.tx: Your spells and attacks have a 20% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.
racials.note: CONFLICT: Zephras shows 20% (spell 1260189); wowforevertalents says the client ships 2 versions (20% and 30%), likely per class; theforeverera says 5% chance for Warriors/Paladins/Rogues and 10% for Priests/Mages/Warlocks (build 70009 note, possibly outdated). Exact per-class values unresolved.

racials.name: Underwater Breathing
racials.tx: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

racials.name: Cultivation
racials.tx: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.
racials.note: theforeverera: every herb has a player-level requirement (Herbalism skill needed / 5); herbs needing >300 skill can be Cultivated at level 60.

racials.name: War Stomp
racials.tx: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.
racials.note: Zephras tooltip has unresolved placeholder ('up to $i enemies'); '5' from wowforevertalents.

racials.name: Endurance
racials.tx: Total Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%.
racials.note: theforeverera says the 2% crit bonus was '1% hit chance' before build 70425 (beta-internal).

racials.name: Plainsrunning
racials.tx: Gain 1% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 30% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect. In addition, you move 3% faster while mounted.

racials.name: Berserking
racials.tx: Increases your casting and attack speed by 10% to 30%. At full health the speed increase is 10% with a greater effect up to 30% if you are badly hurt when you activate the ability. Lasts 10 sec.
racials.note: wowforevertalents flags it changed but shows text identical to Classic; Zephras text is truncated ('10% for ?.'). Nature of change unresolved.

racials.name: Rapid Regeneration
racials.tx: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

racials.name: Beast Slaying
racials.tx: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

racials.name: Regeneration
racials.tx: Health regeneration rate increased by 20%. In addition, 20% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.

racials.name: Skysight
racials.tx: Attempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement and mounted movement speeds by 10%. Lasts 30 sec if no elemental convergence is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

racials.name: Walk on Air
racials.tx: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

racials.name: Elemental Insight
racials.tx: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

racials.name: Wind Blessed
racials.tx: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 3%.
